newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Shipping sell-off to go to 2nd round.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Shipping sell-off to go to 2nd round.

text.p: The Estonian Privatisation agency will call a second round of tenders to decide on one or more bidders to buy a stake in Estonian Shipping, the country's second largest company, the agency said on Friday.
The agency said in a statement that five groups of companies presented bids during the first round which ended on Thursday for a 71 percent stake of the large shipping company.
The bidders included Sweden's Carnegie AB, the Japanese securities house Nomura International PLC and Hansa Investments, news agency BNS reported today.
The companies to be included in the next round of tenders will be announced within 60 days, the agency added.
Estonian Shipping owns about 40 ships and employs 2,385 people, BNS said in a report.
